_comment: SYNTHETIC HELD-OUT scenarios. Do not read these while writing prompts or tuning the agent. Run them only for checkpoint and final evaluations, and record every run.

scenarios.title: First week for a runner
scenarios.userMessage: Set up my week. Mornings are best.

expected.notes: No burpees. Bike and mat only.

scenarios.title: First week for an advanced lifter

expected.notes: Evenings after work; Wednesday volunteering and the Saturday wedding are blocked.

scenarios.title: Review session at lunchtime
scenarios.userMessage: My professor added a review session Tuesday from noon to 1:30.

expected.notes: Seminar follows at 13:30, so Tuesday midday is gone.

scenarios.title: Skipped the gym after a long day
scenarios.userMessage: Skipped the gym tonight, work blew up.

expected.notes: Wednesday evening is too short for 60 min; Saturday evening and Sunday are open.

scenarios.title: Ten minutes before work
scenarios.userMessage: Friday I've only got 10 minutes before work.

expected.notes: A 10-min option or a move to the weekend.

scenarios.title: Broken bike and no running
scenarios.userMessage: The apartment bike is broken and my knee says no running this week.

expected.notes: Walking, yoga, or mobility remain. No medical advice.

scenarios.title: Hackathon through Sunday
scenarios.userMessage: Missed this morning's session and I'm at a hackathon from now until Sunday night.

expected.notes: No time left this week. Skip and say so.

scenarios.title: No heavy barbell work
scenarios.userMessage: No heavy barbell work this week. Doctor's orders.

expected.notes: Respect the restriction without commenting on the medical reason.

scenarios.title: Asks for a 90-minute long run
scenarios.userMessage: Can you put a 90-minute long run on Sunday?

expected.notes: Session cap is 45 min and weekly cap is 4 sessions. Offer what fits and explain the limit.

scenarios.title: Midterm week
scenarios.userMessage: Midterm week: Tuesday and Thursday are out completely, and on Saturday I'd rather walk than do Pilates.

scenarios.title: Redo a week that's already done
scenarios.userMessage: Can you redo my whole week to focus more on yoga?

expected.notes: All sessions are complete and the weekly cap is reached.
